summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a material change report dated August 31, 2026, announcing the accelerated integration of Sanity Group GmbH, which it acquired under a share purchase agreement dated February 18, 2026. The amendment replaces a performance-based earnout with a fixed earnout payable after the earnout period, and lifts the standalone operating requirement. Key executive appointments include Finn Age Hänsel as President, Rest of World and Chief Strategy Officer, and Adrian Frenzel as Global Chief Operating Officer. This is an integration acceleration, not a new acquisition, and no financial terms are disclosed in the excerpt.
